$checkpoint..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name','fileName','time','fileId','fileParts','draftParts']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 100 && newData.child('fileName').isString() && newData.child('fileName').val().length <= 255 && newData.child('time').isNumber() && newData.child('fileId').isString() && newData.child('fileId').val().matches(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/) && newData.child('fileParts').isNumber() && newData.child('fileParts').val() >= 1 && newData.child('fileParts').val() <= 86 && newData.child('draftParts').isNumber() && newData.child('draftParts').val() >= 1 && newData.child('draftParts').val() <= 28
